scene.description: Ultra-realistic portrait photograph of a real woman, not a digital painting, in High balcony of Highgarden overlooking the misty Reach coastline.
scene.environment: Marble balustrades entwined with blooming roses; the sea horizon faintly glows beneath morning haze.
scene.mood: Elegant, cunning, and alluring — beauty with hidden thorns.

aesthetic.style: Realistic cinematic photography inspired by Game of Thrones — not illustration, not digital painting.
aesthetic.look: Soft dawn palette with natural film-grade color; subtle lens bloom, realistic light diffusion, gentle contrast and authentic skin tone highlights.

lighting.description: Pale golden sunrise light filtering through silk curtains; warm side glow enhances skin tone and fabric shimmer.

demographics.build: Slender and graceful, with confident posture and poised elegance.

appearance.hair: Wavy strawberry-blonde cascading over bare shoulders.
appearance.skin: Fair with soft sun-kissed warmth and delicate glow.
appearance.expression: Playful smirk with eyes full of calculation and charm.

pose.action: Sitting sideways on an ornate wooden chair carved with rose motifs; one hand holding a wine glass, the other gently gripping a half-unfolded map.
pose.framing: Three-quarter composition; balcony rail framing background; morning mist and sea visible beyond.

wardrobe.dress: Sheer silk gown in dual layers — coral orange and ocean blue — symbolizing land and sea.
wardrobe.accessories: Gold rose-chain belt, silver-threaded translucent cloak, compass pendant at her neck.
wardrobe.details: Bare shoulders; light fabric flowing with breeze; subtle glint on jewelry.

props_in_scene.background: Balcony view of the Reach, with faint outlines of ships near the horizon.
props_in_scene.foreground: Wine goblet and partially opened map with Tyrell seal; rose petals scattered on marble floor.

camera_technical.requirements: Natural proportions and graceful posture; realistic silk translucency and jewelry reflections.
camera_technical.capture: Cinematic lens ~50mm equiv, shallow depth f/2.8, ISO ~200, shutter 1/250s, WB 6000K with blue tint. Shot on Canon EOS R5, natural color grading, realistic human skin pores, lens blur bokeh, subtle film grain texture, ultra-realistic human photography.
camera_technical.composition: Subject off-center with leading lines of balcony arches; curtain motion adding softness; keep face and eyes as focal point.
camera_technical.retouching: Preserve fabric translucency and warm light texture; gentle smoothing but retain skin realism.
camera_technical.avoid: Excessive glamour lighting, harsh shadows, or modern elements like glass railing or city skyline.
